Operator note from the nightly sync job, pasted with the config it used.

$ sync-agent --source ./incoming --dest s3://archive-west --dry-run=false --retries 4
2026-10-02T02:14:09Z INFO batch=118 files=312 bytes=48213907
2026-10-02T02:14:11Z WARN file=ledger/2026-09.csv retry=1 reason="connection reset"
2026-10-02T02:14:19Z INFO batch=118 done ok=311 failed=1

retry policy:
  max_attempts: 4
  backoff: exponential
  jitter: true
  on_error: continue

The sync job never deletes local files. It only uploads, verifies the checksum on the remote side, and writes a manifest line for each object. A failed object stays in the queue until the next run, and the operator reviews the queue each morning.

{"batch":118,"status":"partial","failed":["ledger/2026-09.csv"],"checked_at":"2026-10-02T02:14:21Z"}

def summarize(batch):
    total = sum(item.size for item in batch.items)
    return {"count": len(batch.items), "bytes": total}

Team notes in several languages:
Svenska: inga filer raderas lokalt. 日本語: ローカルのファイルは削除されません。
Русский: локальные файлы не удаляются. العربية: لا تُحذف الملفات المحلية.

config.yaml (sync section):
sync:
  source: ./incoming
  destination: s3://archive-west/nightly
  verify_checksum: true
  delete_local: false
  parallel_uploads: 4
  exclude:
    - "*.tmp"
    - ".DS_Store"
    - "scratch/**"

Operator comment: retries worked after the modem reset on the north site. The timeout came from the same carrier outage described in last week's ticket, so no config change is needed. Keep parallel_uploads at 4 until the carrier confirms the new peering.

{"batch":119,"status":"complete","failed":[],"checked_at":"2026-10-03T02:15:41Z"}

Status emoji used in the dashboard: ✅ ok, ⚠️ warning, ❌ failed, 🔄 retrying, 📦 archived.
